camel_example: aliyun live DescribeLiveRecordVodConfigs --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName liveStream0000 --PageNum 1 --PageSize 10 --DomainName 'example.com' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AppName liveApp0000
description_en: Queries live-to-VOD configurations of a streaming domain
description_zh: 查询直播转点播配置列表
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-record-vod-configs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveRecordVodConfigs

parameters.help_en: The AppName of the live stream
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Valid values: 5 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页大小。默认值为10，取值范围：5~100
parameters.name: page_size

AppName.description_en: The AppName of the live stream

AutoCompose.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic composition is enabled. Valid values:

ON: enabled.

OFF: disabled
AutoCompose.description_zh:
是否开启自动合并。取值：

ON：开启
OFF：关闭

ComposeVodTranscodeGroupId.description_en:
The ID of the ApsaraVideo VOD transcoding template group for transcoding the composed video created by automatic composition.

This parameter is returned only when `AutoCompose` is set to `ON`
ComposeVodTranscodeGroupId.description_zh:
自动合并点播转码模板组ID。

如果DescribeLiveRecordVodConfigs接口的AutoCompose设置为ON，则返回本参数

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time, in UTC. The time is formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

CycleDuration.description_en: The maximum duration of each recording file. Unit: seconds. Default value: 3600. Range: 300 to 21600
CycleDuration.description_zh: 周期录制时长。单位：秒。默认值为3600，取值范围：300~21600

DelayTime.description_en: The reconnect timeout, in seconds. If a stream is interrupted but recovers within this window, the new content is automatically appended to the exisiting recording file. Otherwise, the previous session is considered ended, and a new recording file will be created. Valid values: 15 to 21600

FormatConfig.description_en: Specifies whether to enable format-specific configuration for VOD processing settings. The default value is true
FormatConfig.description_zh: 按格式配置点播视频设置参数，无需传入，默认为 true

OnDemand.description_en:
The trigger mode of live stream recording. Valid values:

0 (default): Automatic recording.

1: Triggered by callback notifications of on-demand recording.

2: Triggered by corresponding parameters in the stream ingest URL.

7: Triggered manually. By default, recording is disabled. You can call the `RealTimeRecordCommand` operation to manually start or stop recording
OnDemand.description_zh:
按需录制，取值：

0（默认值）：关闭。

1：通过HTTP回调方式。

2：按需录制，通过解析推流参数。。

7：手动录制，默认不录制，可以通过 RealTimeRecordCommand 接口手动控制录制开启或停止

RecordContent.description_en:
The content to record. Valid values:

`raw` (default): Records the source stream.

`transcode`: Records the transcoded streams
RecordContent.description_zh:
录制内容。取值：

raw(默认值)，录制源流

transcode，录制转码流

RecordFormat.description_en: A list of recording format configurations

AutoCompose.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic composition is enabled.

ON: enabled.

OFF: disabled
AutoCompose.description_zh:
自动合并，ON 表示开启自动合并。取值：

ON，开启自动合并

OFF，关闭自动合并

ProcessMethod.description_en:
The video processing method. Valid values:

`transcode`: Processes the video by using a transcoding template group set in ApsaraVideo VOD.

`workflow`: Processes the video by using a workflow set in ApsaraVideo VOD
ProcessMethod.description_zh:
视频处理方式。取值：

transcode，使用转码模版组处理视频

workflow，使用工作流处理视频

ProcessTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the transcoding template group or workflow to use for video processing
ProcessTemplateId.description_zh: 视频处理转码模版或工作流模版Id

SliceDuration.description_en: The duration of a TS segment, in seconds

VideoProcess.description_en:
The video to process. Valid values:

`origin` (default): Processes the source recording files.

`compose`: Processes the composed video
VideoProcess.description_zh:
视频处理源。取值：

origin，处理源视频

compose，处理合并后视频

SpaceId.description_en: The ID of the ApsaraVideo VOD application space. You can find the ID in the ApsaraVideo VOD console or by calling the [ListAppInfo]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454873.html） operation. This parameter is required only if you have enabled application spaces
SpaceId.description_zh: 点播应用空间ID，通过点播控制台或应用信息列表获取，[应用信息查询接口]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454873.html）。未开启应用空间时无需填写；

TranscodeTemplates.description_en: The [transcoding templates]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/45039.html） configured in ApsaraVideo Live. It specifies which transcoded streams to record. A value of `*` indicates that all transcoded streams are recorded
TranscodeTemplates.description_zh: 转码流录制的转码模板。设置了录制所有转码流，则返回为["*"]

VodTranscodeGroupId.description_en: The ID of the ApsaraVideo VOD transcoding template group for transcoding the recording files
